sentences.en: Still, getting these houses above the water required a ton of manpower and big machinery.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，要让这些房子高出水面，仍需要大量的人力和大型机械。

sentences.en: Down by the Caloosahatchee River, massive drag lines and dredges carved a path inland,
sentences.zh: 在卡卢萨哈奇河下游，巨大的挖泥船和疏浚机在内陆开辟了一条通道，

sentences.en: creating miles and miles worth of canals.
sentences.zh: 创造了数英里长的运河。

sentences.en: Aerial photos of all these waterways snaking through residents' backyards
sentences.zh: 所有这些蜿蜒穿过居民后院的水道航拍照片，

sentences.en: would soon wind up on postcards and in magazines.
sentences.zh: 很快就会出现在明信片和杂志上。

sentences.en: But they weren't just for show.
sentences.zh: 但它们不仅仅是为了展示。

sentences.en: Because the canals are also how the Rosens created the actual land
sentences.zh: 因为这些运河也是罗森兄弟创造实际土地的方式，

sentences.en: that they would eventually build houses on.
sentences.zh: 他们最终会在这些土地上盖房子。

sentences.en: As the dredges worked their way through this swampy terrain,
sentences.zh: 当疏浚机在这片沼泽地带作业时，

sentences.en: they'd dump all that dirt from the bottom of the river in giant piles alongside it.
sentences.zh: 他们会把从河底挖出的所有泥土堆在河边，堆成巨大的土堆。

sentences.en: And because all that crud from the riverbed is free,
sentences.zh: 而且因为河床里的这些淤泥是免费的，

sentences.en: the Rosens simply graded these piles of muck and voila, land.
sentences.zh: 罗森兄弟只需把这些泥堆平整一下，瞧，土地就有了。

sentences.en: And so this isn't beach sand that you're pulling up.
sentences.zh: 所以你挖出来的可不是海滩上的沙子。

sentences.en: It smells, it's horrible.
sentences.zh: 它有臭味，非常难闻。

sentences.en: Flies, you know, the dead shells, the dead sea crabs, the dead vegetation.
sentences.zh: 苍蝇，你知道的，还有死贝壳、死海蟹、死植被。

sentences.en: And it was just some of the descriptions from Cape Coral in the early days.
sentences.zh: 这只是早期对珊瑚角的描述之一。

sentences.en: It was kind of biblical.
sentences.zh: 简直就像圣经里描述的那样。

sentences.en: Developments like Cape Coral destroyed mangroves and paved over wetlands,
sentences.zh: 像珊瑚角这样的开发项目摧毁了红树林，填平了湿地，

sentences.en: areas that naturally absorb floodwaters and reduce storm surges.
sentences.zh: 而这些地区本可以自然吸收洪水并减少风暴潮。

sentences.en: Experts call this land a hurricane buffer zone.
sentences.zh: 专家称这片土地为飓风缓冲区。

sentences.en: But the Rosens and developers all over Florida were tearing these environments apart
sentences.zh: 但罗森兄弟和佛罗里达州各地的开发商却在破坏这些环境，

sentences.en: and building homes there instead.
sentences.zh: 转而在那里盖房子。

sentences.en: Residential lots in Gulf American's new city were sold on installments,
sentences.zh: 海湾美国公司新城市里的住宅地块以分期付款的方式出售，

sentences.en: $20 down and $20 a month.
sentences.zh: 首付20美元，每月20美元。

sentences.en: In some of the earliest layouts, you can see tens of thousands of home sites color-coded as tiny, equally-sized rectangles.
sentences.zh: 在一些最早的规划图中，你可以看到成千上万个用颜色编码的住宅区，就像一个个微小且大小相同的矩形。

sentences.en: At first, Gulf American didn't even bother to include space in the plans for a school or a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 起初，海湾美国公司甚至懒得在规划中为学校或杂货店预留空间。

sentences.en: They wanted to squeeze as many lots as they could out of this swamp.
sentences.zh: 他们想从这片沼泽地里挤出尽可能多的地块。

sentences.en: And as it turns out, there was a real appetite for what they were selling.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，人们对他们兜售的东西确实很感兴趣。

sentences.en: We were motivating people to leave their home up north and come down here and live with us.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在激励人们离开北方的家，来到这里和我们一起生活。

sentences.en: So we didn't tell no lies.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有撒谎。

sentences.en: We didn't even stretch the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至没有夸大事实。

sentences.en: This is Joseph Razo, a salesman at Gulf American.
sentences.zh: 这是约瑟夫·拉佐，海湾美国公司的一名推销员。

sentences.en: In an old recording, Joseph spoke about his time at the company selling this new city on the water.
sentences.zh: 在一份旧录音中，约瑟夫讲述了他在公司推销这座水上新城的时光。

sentences.en: When he first arrived, Cape Coral was actually hit by a massive hurricane,
sentences.zh: 他刚到的时候，珊瑚角正好遭遇了一场大型飓风，

sentences.en: ripping roofs off houses and flooding some roads and homes.
sentences.zh: 掀翻了屋顶，淹没了部分道路和房屋。

sentences.en: But he says that didn't stop the company from forging ahead.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，这并没有阻止公司继续前进。

sentences.en: The very next day, we sold a couple houses and we sold lots of land with the people that came here.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，我们卖出了几套房子，还向来到这里的人卖出了许多土地。

sentences.en: Like I said, the people that came down believed in the things we told them.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，来到这里的人相信我们告诉他们的一切。

sentences.en: And they believed.
sentences.zh: 他们相信了。

sentences.en: And they bought it.
sentences.zh: 他们买下了。

sentences.en: Golf American's marketing was unlike anything Florida had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 海湾美国公司的营销方式是佛罗里达州前所未见的。

sentences.en: At one point, the company spent more money advertising the Florida lifestyle than the state of Florida did.
sentences.zh: 有段时间，该公司在宣传佛罗里达生活方式上投入的资金比佛罗里达州政府还要多。

sentences.en: They hired teams to travel the Northeast and the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 他们雇佣团队前往东北部和中西部地区。

sentences.en: At local hotels, they'd offer customers free chicken dinners
sentences.zh: 在当地的酒店里，他们会为顾客提供免费的鸡肉晚餐，

sentences.en: and show them a movie about Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 并向他们播放一部关于珊瑚角的电影。

sentences.en: Sometimes, salespeople would close the deal by the end of the night.
sentences.zh: 有时，推销员在当晚结束前就能达成交易。

sentences.en: And for anyone who still needed a little convincing,
sentences.zh: 对于那些还需要一点说服力的人，

sentences.en: Gulf American booked them on an all-expense-paid trip
sentences.zh: 海湾美国公司会为他们预订一次全额付费的旅行，

sentences.en: down to their waterfront wonderland.
sentences.zh: 前往他们的滨水仙境。

sentences.en: We used to bring them here by air, by bus, by train, by boat,
sentences.zh: 我们过去常通过飞机、巴士、火车、船只把他们带到这里，

sentences.en: any way that we could bring them here,
sentences.zh: 任何能把他们带到这里的方式，

sentences.en: we brought them here.
sentences.zh: 我们都用了。

sentences.en: So it would fly you in
sentences.zh: 所以他们会用飞机把你接来，

sentences.en: and you'd bring your kids
sentences.zh: 你带着孩子，

sentences.en: and you would stay in their clutches,
sentences.zh: 然后你就会待在他们的掌控之中，

sentences.en: so in their hotel,
sentences.zh: 也就是在他们的酒店里，

sentences.en: within their bus route,
sentences.zh: 在他们的巴士路线上，

sentences.en: and they had you captive.
sentences.zh: 你就像被俘虏了一样。

sentences.en: Gloria Razo Tate is Joseph Razo's daughter.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚·拉佐·泰特是约瑟夫·拉佐的女儿。

sentences.en: She was just nine years old
sentences.zh: 她当时只有九岁，

sentences.en: when the family moved to Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 全家搬到了珊瑚角。

sentences.en: And when her dad joined the sales team,
sentences.zh: 当她父亲加入销售团队时，

sentences.en: she got a job of her own too.
sentences.zh: 她也得到了一份自己的工作。

sentences.en: It was just a little more informal.
sentences.zh: 那只是一份比较非正式的工作。

sentences.en: And my sister and I were babysitters, so we would take the kids and say...
sentences.zh: 我和我姐姐是保姆，所以我们会带着孩子们说……

sentences.en: You would take the kids and the people who came?
sentences.zh: 你会带着孩子们和那些来访的人？

sentences.en: Yes, who came on the flying by us and take them to the beach.
sentences.zh: 是的，那些坐飞机来的人，带他们去海滩。

sentences.en: And, you know, they would be in love with this place.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们会爱上这个地方。

sentences.en: We want to move here.
sentences.zh: 我们想搬到这里。

sentences.en: We want to move here.
sentences.zh: 我们想搬到这里。

sentences.en: We fed them breakfaSt. We fed them lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们给他们提供早餐、午餐。

sentences.en: We fed them dinner.
sentences.zh: 我们给他们提供晚餐。

sentences.en: Prime rib.
sentences.zh: 优质肋排。

sentences.en: Never cheap.
sentences.zh: 从不廉价。

sentences.en: I was so sick of prime rib, you couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我当时吃优质肋排吃到想吐，你根本无法想象。

sentences.en: Once the deal closed, a Gulf American pilot would fly you up in a Cessna
sentences.zh: 交易达成后，海湾美国公司的飞行员会开着塞斯纳飞机带你上天，

sentences.en: to show you your slice of paradise.
sentences.zh: 向你展示你那片天堂。

sentences.en: From the sky, customers would see this Pac-Man-like maze of canals and houses.
sentences.zh: 从空中看，顾客会看到这种像吃豆人一样的运河和房屋迷宫。

sentences.en: By the late 1960s, Gulf American had sold so many lots,
sentences.zh: 到20世纪60年代末，海湾美国公司已经卖出了太多的地块，

sentences.en: it was sometimes hard to tell a customer just which piece of land was theirs.
sentences.zh: 有时很难告诉顾客到底哪一块地是他们的。

sentences.en: And the pilot has a bag of flour or sugar, and he leans out the window,
sentences.zh: 飞行员会拿一袋面粉或糖，探出窗外，

sentences.en: and he goes, your lot is right there, and he drops the bag.
sentences.zh: 然后说，你的地就在那儿，接着把袋子扔下去。

sentences.en: And the bag lands on the ground and goes, poof!
sentences.zh: 袋子落在地上，砰的一声！

sentences.en: This pluff of white, and who knows where it went?
sentences.zh: 白烟散开，谁知道它掉哪儿去了？

sentences.en: And who knows where that land was?
sentences.zh: 谁又知道那块地在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: I mean, let's be honest, a lot of people had no clue what they were buying in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我是说，老实说，很多人根本不知道自己在佛罗里达买了什么。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's the way it rolled.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，事情就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: Jack and Leonard Rosen started out like a lot of other Florida developers,
sentences.zh: 杰克和伦纳德·罗森兄弟起初和许多其他佛罗里达开发商一样，

sentences.en: trying to spit-shine some swampy land to sell to a bunch of dopes up north.
sentences.zh: 试图把一些沼泽地包装得光鲜亮丽，卖给北方的一群傻瓜。

sentences.en: And the plan?
sentences.zh: 至于计划？

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 它成功了。

sentences.en: Lots of people started moving to their city.
sentences.zh: 很多人开始搬到他们的城市。

sentences.en: Between 1970 and 1980, the population of Cape Coral tripled to over 30,000.
sentences.zh: 1970年至1980年间，珊瑚角的人口增加了两倍，超过了3万人。

sentences.en: And as time went on, the land just kept filling in.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这片土地不断被填满。

sentences.en: Today, more than 200,000 people call the city home.
sentences.zh: 如今，超过20万人口以这座城市为家。

sentences.en: But Cape Coral has a problem, one that stems from its original sin.
sentences.zh: 但珊瑚角有一个问题，一个源于其原罪的问题。

sentences.en: The whole premise of the city was to use canals to put as many single-family homes on the water as they possibly could.
sentences.zh: 这座城市最初的前提就是利用运河，尽可能多地在水边建造独栋住宅。

sentences.en: Today, it has over 400 miles worth of canals, the most of any city anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 如今，它拥有超过400英里的运河，是世界上任何城市中最多的。

sentences.en: However, as the seas rise and storms get worse and worse,
sentences.zh: 然而，随着海平面上升，风暴变得越来越严重，

sentences.en: what used to be Cape Coral's biggest asset has turned into its biggest liability.
sentences.zh: 曾经是珊瑚角最大资产的东西，现在变成了它最大的负担。

sentences.en: You know, when do these canal front properties that weren't really smart to build in the beginning,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些当初建造时并不明智的运河房产，

sentences.en: now they're downright dangerous to live on?
sentences.zh: 现在住起来简直危险重重，到底该怎么办？

sentences.en: Some huge number of Cape Coral is flood-prone as we speak.
sentences.zh: 目前珊瑚角有很大一部分地区容易发生洪水。

sentences.en: A recent study suggests that nearly 90% of properties in Cape Coral are at risk of flooding.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项研究表明，珊瑚角近90%的房产面临洪水风险。

sentences.en: That's more than 110,000 homes, the most of any city in Florida.
sentences.zh: 那可是超过11万套住宅，是佛罗里达州所有城市中最多的。

sentences.en: The development of all this swampy land was risky even before the effects of climate change became super clear.
sentences.zh: 即使在气候变化的影响变得非常明显之前，开发所有这些沼泽地也是有风险的。

sentences.en: But at the same time the Razos and the Rosens were selling the city, there was another development happening.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，当拉佐一家和罗森兄弟在推销这座城市时，另一个发展趋势正在发生。

sentences.en: This time in the insurance market.
sentences.zh: 这次是在保险市场上。

sentences.en: And it would make it harder for newcomers to really understand the true risk of living in Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 这会让新来者更难真正理解住在珊瑚角的真实风险。

sentences.en: After the break, how we all ended up paying for the Florida dream.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将探讨我们是如何最终为这个佛罗里达梦买单的。

sentences.en: In the 1950s, America was in the middle of the post-war housing boom.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代，美国正处于战后住房繁荣期。

sentences.en: And lots of construction was happening.
sentences.zh: 大量的建设工程正在进行。

sentences.en: It just wasn't always in the safest places.
sentences.zh: 只是它们并不总是在最安全的地方。

sentences.en: That was especially true in Florida, where the Rosens were dredging and filling swamps at warp speed.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州尤其如此，罗森兄弟正以极快的速度疏浚和填平沼泽。

sentences.en: Those types of changes to the landscape come back to haunt communities
sentences.zh: 这种对景观的改变会反过来困扰社区，

sentences.en: because the water still comes and still needs somewhere to go.
sentences.zh: 因为水终究会来，而且总得有个去处。

sentences.en: This is Carolyn Kuski.
sentences.zh: 这是卡罗琳·库斯基。

sentences.en: She studies policy and climate risk at the Environmental Defense Fund.
sentences.zh: 她在环境国防基金会研究政策和气候风险。

sentences.en: Carolyn says that communities that build themselves on top of wetlands
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳说，那些在湿地上建立起来的社区，

sentences.en: unsurprisingly have a greater chance of flooding.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，发生洪水的几率更高。

sentences.en: And for a long time, if residents wanted to insure against that risk, they couldn't.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，如果居民想要为这种风险投保，他们根本做不到。

sentences.en: No private companies wanted to sell flood insurance
sentences.zh: 没有私营公司愿意出售洪水保险，

sentences.en: because a big flood could bankrupt and actually had bankrupted a lot of insurers.
sentences.zh: 因为一场大洪水可能会让保险公司破产，实际上也确实让许多保险公司破产过。

sentences.en: So the cost of helping homeowners rebuild after a flood
sentences.zh: 因此，帮助房主在洪水后重建的成本，

sentences.en: increasingly fell to the federal government,
sentences.zh: 越来越多地落在了联邦政府身上，

sentences.en: which found itself paying out loads of money in disaster aid.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府发现自己不得不支付巨额的灾难援助金。

sentences.en: And there start being conversations that disaster aid is getting to be
sentences.zh: 于是开始有人讨论，灾难援助对联邦政府来说，

sentences.en: pretty pricey for the federal government
sentences.zh: 变得越来越昂贵，

sentences.en: and insurance would be a way to help spread the cost,
sentences.zh: 而保险将是一种分摊成本的方式，

sentences.en: but also to encourage better development in our floodplains.
sentences.zh: 同时也能鼓励在我们的洪泛区进行更好的开发。

sentences.en: And so the sort of national conversation around a potential flood insurance program begins in the 50s and 60s and then is finally adopted in 1968.
sentences.zh: 因此，围绕潜在洪水保险计划的全国性讨论始于50和60年代，并最终在1968年被采纳。

sentences.en: The National Flood Insurance Program, or the NFIP, is an insurance program run by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 国家洪水保险计划，即NFIP，是由联邦政府运营的保险计划。

sentences.en: And one of its main goals was to discourage people from buying in places they probably shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 其主要目标之一是劝阻人们在不该买房的地方买房。

sentences.en: Residents who purchase flood insurance policies are having to see the cost of risk when they make those premium payments.
sentences.zh: 购买洪水保险的居民在支付保费时，必须直面风险成本。

sentences.en: And the thought is that that is then going to encourage people to be more careful about moving into incredibly risky areas.
sentences.zh: 人们认为，这将鼓励人们在搬入风险极高的地区时更加谨慎。

sentences.en: FEMA, who runs the NFIP, knew it needed a critical mass of customers to make the program work.
sentences.zh: 负责运营NFIP的联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）知道，它需要大量的客户才能使该计划发挥作用。

sentences.en: Insurance, after all, is a numbers game.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，保险是一场数字游戏。

sentences.en: The more people you get inside the program, the more you can spread out the cost of a disaster.
sentences.zh: 加入计划的人越多，分摊灾难成本的能力就越强。

sentences.en: But at least initially, communities weren't like, hell yeah, flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 但至少在最初，社区并没有表现出“太棒了，洪水保险”的态度。

sentences.en: Because as it turns out, it's really hard to get people to buy a thing for something that might happen at some point in the future.
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，要让人们为未来某个时候可能发生的事情买单，真的很难。

sentences.en: So to get homeowners into the program, the federal government did two things.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了让房主加入该计划，联邦政府做了两件事。

sentences.en: First, they mandated that if you have a mortgage on a house in a high-risk flood zone,
sentences.zh: 首先，他们规定，如果你在高风险洪水区的房子有抵押贷款，

sentences.en: you had to buy flood insurance, which, you know, that makes good sense.
sentences.zh: 你就必须购买洪水保险，你知道，这很有道理。

sentences.en: And crucially, they also offered residents living in flood-prone communities a subsidy,
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，他们还为居住在易受洪水影响社区的居民提供了补贴，

sentences.en: or what's essentially a discount, giving people the benefits of flood insurance,
sentences.zh: 或者说本质上是一种折扣，让人们享受到洪水保险的好处，

sentences.en: but at a cheaper rate than the actual risk they faced.
sentences.zh: 但费率却比他们实际面临的风险要低。

sentences.en: And so this discount is built into flood insurance prices from the beginning,
sentences.zh: 所以这种折扣从一开始就内置在洪水保险价格中，

sentences.en: And the thought was it would phase out quickly as homes turned over, newer homes were built, and it's supposed to be eliminated if there's major retrofits or anything.
sentences.zh: 人们原以为随着房屋转手、新房建成，这种折扣会迅速淘汰，而且如果进行了重大改造等，它本应被取消。

sentences.en: And it turned out to be just really sticky.
sentences.zh: 结果发现它真的很难摆脱。

sentences.en: At least early on, there were some good reasons for the discount.
sentences.zh: 至少在早期，这种折扣是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: FEMA didn't want to punish residents who had already purchased homes in a flood zone, even before the program existed.
sentences.zh: 联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）不想惩罚那些在该项目存在之前就已经在洪泛区购买房屋的居民。

sentences.en: So the discount was a tool to help ease people in.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种折扣是一种帮助人们过渡的工具。

sentences.en: and it was supposed to eventually go away,
sentences.zh: 而且它本应最终取消，

sentences.en: but it just never did.
sentences.zh: 但却从未取消过。

sentences.en: And there are other ways the flood insurance program
sentences.zh: 此外，洪水保险项目还有其他方式

sentences.en: has underpriced risk.
sentences.zh: 对风险的定价过低。

sentences.en: For one, FEMA has historically used flood maps
sentences.zh: 首先，FEMA历来使用洪水地图

sentences.en: to price premiums,
sentences.zh: 来确定保费价格，

sentences.en: but those maps are notoriously outdated
sentences.zh: 但这些地图出了名的过时，

sentences.en: and often fail to accurately identify flood-prone areas.
sentences.zh: 而且往往无法准确识别易受洪水影响的区域。

sentences.en: So over the years,
sentences.zh: 所以多年来，

sentences.en: lots of people with significant flood risk
sentences.zh: 许多面临重大洪水风险的人

sentences.en: were shown on the map as living in a pretty safe area,
sentences.zh: 在地图上被显示为居住在相当安全的区域，

sentences.en: and they ended up getting cheaper rates because of it.
sentences.zh: 因此他们最终获得了更便宜的费率。

sentences.en: The current system greatly underprices flood insurance,
sentences.zh: 目前的体系极大地低估了洪水保险的价格，

sentences.en: which is why it's so great for those of us who buy flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么对于我们这些购买洪水保险的人来说，它非常棒。

sentences.en: We think it's great.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这很棒。

sentences.en: Bill Spakowski is a city planner who lives just outside of Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 比尔·斯帕科夫斯基（Bill Spakowski）是一位住在珊瑚角（Cape Coral）郊外的城市规划师。

sentences.en: I think I pay $700 a year for my house.
sentences.zh: 我想我每年为我的房子支付700美元。

sentences.en: They have $700 a year for flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 他们的洪水保险每年只需700美元。

sentences.en: Even Bill acknowledges that this is a bargain.
sentences.zh: 即使是比尔也承认这很划算。

sentences.en: He says the flood insurance program holds a lot of power over this part of the country.
sentences.zh: 他说，洪水保险项目对该国这一地区有着很大的影响力。

sentences.en: In Cape Coral alone, there are over 27,000 flood insurance policies
sentences.zh: 仅在珊瑚角，就有超过27,000份洪水保险保单

sentences.en: through the NFIP.
sentences.zh: 是通过国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）购买的。

sentences.en: And for decades, lots of residents
sentences.zh: 几十年来，许多居民

sentences.en: have been getting a pretty sweet deal
sentences.zh: 一直享受着相当不错的待遇，

sentences.en: because flood insurance was just cheaper
sentences.zh: 因为洪水保险的价格比它本应有的水平

sentences.en: than it should have been,
sentences.zh: 要便宜得多，

sentences.en: particularly for the wealthiest homeowners.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对最富有的房主而言。

sentences.en: FEMA knows that its rates have been a problem.
sentences.zh: FEMA知道其费率一直是个问题。

sentences.en: It's just that any time they try to correct them,
sentences.zh: 只是每当他们试图纠正这些费率时，

sentences.en: everyone revolts.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会反抗。

sentences.en: As soon as the new insurance rates come out,
sentences.zh: 一旦新的保险费率出台，

sentences.en: citizens call their congressmen
sentences.zh: 公民们就会给他们的国会议员打电话，

sentences.en: and the congressmen, being elected officials,
sentences.zh: 而作为民选官员的国会议员们，

sentences.en: scream and yell, how could you do this?
sentences.zh: 就会大喊大叫：你们怎么能这样做？

sentences.en: and they roll it back.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会撤回这些费率。

sentences.en: The reason FEMA wants to raise rates
sentences.zh: FEMA想要提高费率的原因

sentences.en: is because the program runs at a massive deficit
sentences.zh: 是因为该项目背负着巨额赤字，

sentences.en: to the tune of some $20 billion.
sentences.zh: 高达约200亿美元。

sentences.en: So as disasters keep piling on,
sentences.zh: 因此，随着灾难不断堆积，

sentences.en: the program has to borrow from us, taxpayers,
sentences.zh: 该项目不得不向我们这些纳税人借钱，

sentences.en: to help pay its obligations.
sentences.zh: 以帮助支付其债务。

sentences.en: And the NFIP hasn't just been a boon to Florida homeowners,
sentences.zh: 而且NFIP不仅对佛罗里达州的房主来说是一项福利，

sentences.en: but for local governments who want to see their cities grow.
sentences.zh: 对那些希望看到城市发展的当地政府来说也是如此。

sentences.en: Local governments have a bit of a perverse incentive
sentences.zh: 地方政府有一种扭曲的动机，

sentences.en: to allow excessive development in risky areas
sentences.zh: 即允许在危险区域进行过度开发，

sentences.en: because they get the property tax revenue from it.
sentences.zh: 因为他们能从中获得房产税收入。

sentences.en: But when those homes are damaged,
sentences.zh: 但当这些房屋受损时，

sentences.en: the local government doesn't pay any of the costs of those damages.
sentences.zh: 地方政府却无需承担任何损失赔偿费用。

sentences.en: So they just get the nice benefits in the safe years
sentences.zh: 所以他们在平安无事的年份里只享受好处，

sentences.en: and don't have to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 而不必处理后续问题。

sentences.en: When it floods, it's not their problem.
sentences.zh: 当洪水来袭时，那不是他们的问题。

sentences.en: It's on the owner or the federal government.
sentences.zh: 那是业主或联邦政府的事。

sentences.en: In theory, the NFIP was supposed to act as a disincentive,
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，NFIP本应起到抑制作用，

sentences.en: a tool that would make living in the floodplains pricey
sentences.zh: 作为一种让居住在洪泛区变得昂贵的工具，

sentences.en: and even steer some residents outside of a flood zone.
sentences.zh: 甚至引导一些居民搬离洪泛区。

sentences.en: But in reality, it hasn't worked out that way.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: The flood insurance program didn't rein in risky development.
sentences.zh: 洪水保险项目并没有遏制危险的开发。

sentences.en: The discounted policies blinded people to the amount of risk they were actually taking on,
sentences.zh: 折扣保单让人们对他们实际承担的风险视而不见，

sentences.en: which gave people an incentive to move into risky places like Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 这反而激励了人们搬到像珊瑚角这样危险的地方。

sentences.en: After all, who wouldn't want their Florida dream subsidized by the federal government?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，谁不想让自己的佛罗里达梦由联邦政府补贴呢？

sentences.en: Would Cape Coral exist as it is today had there not been a federal program as a backstop to cover against flood loss?
sentences.zh: 如果没有联邦项目作为抵御洪水损失的后盾，珊瑚角还会像今天这样存在吗？

sentences.en: Um, I don't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: This is Wyatt Daltrey.
sentences.zh: 这位是怀亚特·达尔特里（Wyatt Daltrey）。

sentences.en: In addition to being on the planning team for Cape Coral, he's also the city's floodplain manager.
sentences.zh: 除了是珊瑚角的规划团队成员外，他还是该市的洪泛区经理。

sentences.en: I spoke to Wyatt a few months back in a small conference room down in Cape Coral City Hall.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我在珊瑚角市政厅的一个小会议室里采访了怀亚特。

sentences.en: As far as the NFIP is concerned, I think we would still exiSt.
sentences.zh: 就NFIP而言，我认为我们仍然会存在。

sentences.en: I don't think we would be as large.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们会像现在这么大。

sentences.en: So to some degree, it incentivizes a growth in this area.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，它刺激了该地区的增长。

sentences.en: I think it helped supercharge the growth we've seen in Southwest Florida.
sentences.zh: 我认为它助力了我们在佛罗里达州西南部所看到的增长。

sentences.en: The flood insurance program was created to fill a gap left by the private market.
sentences.zh: 洪水保险项目是为了填补私人市场留下的空白而创建的。

sentences.en: And today, a similar dynamic is playing out on the state level with homeowners insurance,
sentences.zh: 如今，类似的动态正在州一级的房主保险中上演，

sentences.en: a policy that's completely separate from flood insurance
sentences.zh: 这是一项与洪水保险完全独立的政策，

sentences.en: and one that's required by lenders on all mortgages
sentences.zh: 也是贷款机构对所有抵押贷款所要求的，

sentences.en: so it affects even more people.
sentences.zh: 因此它影响的人群甚至更多。

sentences.en: Companies that sell homeowners insurance
sentences.zh: 销售房主保险的公司

sentences.en: are starting to get really freaked out about climate change
sentences.zh: 开始对气候变化感到非常恐慌，

sentences.en: and these businesses are deciding
sentences.zh: 这些企业正在做出决定，

sentences.en: that some places have become so risky
sentences.zh: 认为某些地方已经变得风险太大，

sentences.en: that they're effectively uninsurable.
sentences.zh: 以至于实际上无法投保。

sentences.en: So rather than stick around and lose money
sentences.zh: 因此，与其留下来赔钱，

sentences.en: lots of companies are choosing to abandon
sentences.zh: 许多公司选择放弃

sentences.en: the riskiest locations
sentences.zh: 风险最高的地区。

sentences.en: And just like with flood insurance, as those private companies leave,
sentences.zh: 就像洪水保险一样，随着这些私营公司的离开，

sentences.en: the state has had to step in, creating and expanding their own home insurance prograMs.
sentences.zh: 州政府不得不介入，创建并扩大他们自己的家庭保险项目。

sentences.en: 30-odd states now have a state-run program, including California,
sentences.zh: 目前有30多个州拥有州营项目，包括加利福尼亚州，

sentences.en: which is dramatically expanding that program right now to protect the state's economy
sentences.zh: 该州目前正在大幅扩大该项目以保护州经济，

sentences.en: and protect that growth that's so vital to the economy.
sentences.zh: 并保护对经济至关重要的增长。

sentences.en: Abram Lusgarten is a climate reporter at ProPublica.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕·拉斯加滕（Abram Lusgarten）是ProPublica的气候记者。

sentences.en: He says that these state-run home insurance programs
sentences.zh: 他说，这些州营的家庭保险项目

sentences.en: act as a backstop,
sentences.zh: 充当了后盾，

sentences.en: helping to keep lots of at-risk communities
sentences.zh: 帮助维持了许多高风险社区的

sentences.en: financially viable,
sentences.zh: 财务可行性，

sentences.en: which is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件好事。

sentences.en: But they're also kind of obscuring
sentences.zh: 但它们也在某种程度上掩盖了

sentences.en: an uncomfortable truth.
sentences.zh: 一个令人不安的事实。

sentences.en: Because when the private market says
sentences.zh: 因为当私人市场说

sentences.en: a place is uninsurable,
sentences.zh: 一个地方无法投保时，

sentences.en: that's a warning sign to everyone
sentences.zh: 这对居住在该地区的每个人来说都是一个警告信号：

sentences.en: living in the area.
sentences.zh: 这个地方很危险。

sentences.en: This place is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但州政府的项目却发出了不同的信号。

sentences.en: But the state programs send a different message.
sentences.zh: 它们告诉你这个地方没问题。

sentences.en: They tell you this place is okay.
sentences.zh: 或者至少还过得去。

sentences.en: Or at least okay enough.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的悖论。

sentences.en: And that's sort of the paradox.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拥有这些系统，它们让人们对风险视而不见，并鼓励我们所有人居住在非常脆弱的地方。

sentences.en: So we have these systems that have blinded people to risk and encouraged us all to live in very vulnerable places.
sentences.zh: 而且有太多人这样做了，以至于现在我们确实有非常迫切的需求来保护其中一些人。

sentences.en: And so many people have done that, that now we do have a very genuine need to protect some of those people.
sentences.zh: 因此，一方面，随着全国各地面临越来越严重的气候威胁，

sentences.en: So, on the one hand, as places all around the country face more and more severe climate threats,
sentences.zh: 继续鼓励人们居住在危险区域可能不是一个好主意。

sentences.en: it's probably not a great idea to keep encouraging people to live in risky areas.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，那些地方已经居住了很多人。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, there already are a lot of people in those places.
sentences.zh: 如果当私营公司撤离时，州政府或联邦政府拒绝介入，

sentences.en: And if the state or the federal government refuse to step in when the private companies flee,
sentences.zh: 许多人可能根本没有任何保险选择。

sentences.en: lots of people might be left without any insurance options at all.
sentences.zh: 我在加利福尼亚州拥有一套房子。

sentences.en: I own a home in California.
sentences.zh: 我非常害怕失去我的保险，害怕那种前景。

sentences.en: I'm petrified of losing my insurance, of the prospect of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想看到我的保险消失。

sentences.en: So I don't want to see my insurance go away.
sentences.zh: 如果它真的消失了，我也不想看到我所在的州提供的后盾消失，

sentences.en: And if it were to go away, I don't want to see my state-offered backstop go away
sentences.zh: 因为没有它，我不知道我该怎么办。

sentences.en: because without it, I don't know what I would do.
sentences.zh: 州营家庭保险项目和低成本洪水保险

sentences.en: State-run home insurance programs and low-cost flood insurance
sentences.zh: 帮助保护了大多数人最宝贵的资产。

sentences.en: have helped protect what is, for most people, their most valuable asset.
sentences.zh: 但它们也加剧了一个类似的问题。

sentences.en: But they've also compounded a similar problem.
sentences.zh: 它们让人们更难真正去考虑居住在像珊瑚角这样的地方所面临的危险。

sentences.en: They've made it harder for people to really consider the perils
sentences.zh: 但风险一直都在那里。

sentences.en: of living in a place like Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 而且最近它们变得显而易见，每个人都能看到。

sentences.en: But the risks were always there.
sentences.zh: 我看到了。

sentences.en: And they recently became plain for everyone to see.
sentences.zh: 那是2023年8月下旬，我刚把车开进车道，玛丽恩·莫里斯（Marion Morris）就出来迎接我了。

sentences.en: I see it.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: It's late August 2023, and I just pulled into a driveway where I'm greeted by Marion Morris.
sentences.zh: 嗨，杰森。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 是，是，是，是。

sentences.en: Hi, Jason.
sentences.zh: 我听见狗叫了。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 玛丽恩和她的丈夫劳埃德（Lloyd）以及几只宠物住在珊瑚角。

sentences.en: I hear the dogs.
sentences.zh: 我拜访的那天，高温指数在110华氏度左右，

sentences.en: Marion lives in Cape Coral with her husband Lloyd and a handful of pets.
sentences.zh: 外面正在酝酿一场典型的下午5点钟的暴风雨。

sentences.en: On the day I visit, the heat index is right around 110,
sentences.zh: 为了避开这闷热的天气，

sentences.en: and a classic 5 o'clock storm is brewing outside.
sentences.zh: 我们把寒暄挪到了玛丽恩的厨房里。

sentences.en: So to get out of this soupy mess,
sentences.zh: 在那里，她递给我一些水，

sentences.en: we move all the pleasantries into Marion's kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我看到一只猫从走廊尽头探出头来。

sentences.en: There, she offers me some water,
sentences.zh: 在桌子上，玛丽恩指着一张非常温馨的家庭照片。

sentences.en: and I see a cat poke its head out from down the hall.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，那是我。

sentences.en: On a table, Marion points to a very sweet family photo.
sentences.zh: 那是你吗？

sentences.en: That was me, believe it or not.
sentences.zh: 对，那是我的，那也是我的。

sentences.en: That's you right there?
sentences.zh: 那是我丈夫。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's me, and that's me.
sentences.zh: 看看岁月对你做了什么。

sentences.en: That's my husband.
sentences.zh: 猜猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Look what age does to you.
sentences.zh: 等你老了就不会这么可爱了。

sentences.en: Guess what?
sentences.zh: 我快要有我的第一个孩子了。

sentences.en: You're not going to be so cute when you get older.
sentences.zh: 玛丽恩70多岁了，最近刚退休。

sentences.en: I'm about to have my first kids.
sentences.zh: 玛丽恩70多岁了，最近刚退休。

sentences.en: Marion is in her 70s and recently retired.
sentences.zh: 玛丽恩70多岁了，最近刚退休。

sentences.en: She moved to Cape Coral after her aunt passed away and left her this house.
sentences.zh: 她姑姑去世后把这栋房子留给了她，于是她搬到了珊瑚角。

sentences.en: It's a classic mid-century Florida ranch,
sentences.zh: 这是一栋典型的佛罗里达州世纪中期牧场式住宅，

sentences.en: single story with a carport on the side and a lanai in the back.
sentences.zh: 单层结构，侧面带车棚，后面有凉廊。

sentences.en: It's actually one of Gulf American's original homes,
sentences.zh: 它实际上是海湾美国公司（Gulf American）最初建造的房屋之一，

sentences.en: but not just any of the original homes.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是普通的原始房屋。

sentences.en: A home in Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达的一处家园。

sentences.en: That's our home.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She lives in the place that was given away on The Price is Right all those years ago.
sentences.zh: 她住的地方，正是多年前在《价格猜猜猜》（The Price is Right）节目中作为奖品送出的那套房子。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就在那儿。

sentences.en: Look.
sentences.zh: 看。

sentences.en: I played Marion the clip you heard earlier on my phone while we huddled around her kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 我们围坐在她家的餐桌旁，我给玛丽昂播放了之前你听到的那段录音。

sentences.en: Did you know it?
sentences.zh: 你知道这事吗？

sentences.en: So you didn't know any of that history of The Price is Right?
sentences.zh: 所以你完全不知道《价格猜猜猜》的这段历史？

sentences.en: No, and I don't think my aunt did either.
sentences.zh: 不知道，我想我姑姑也不知道。

sentences.en: This is 60-
sentences.zh: 这是60-

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: Price is right.
sentences.zh: 价格猜猜猜。

sentences.en: Marion was born in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂出生在俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: And she first started coming down to Cape Coral in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 她是在70年代第一次开始来珊瑚角的。

sentences.en: That's when her aunt bought the place.
sentences.zh: 那时她姑姑买下了这处房产。

sentences.en: I used to drive down here three, four times a year for vacation.
sentences.zh: 我以前每年都要开车来这里度假三四次。

sentences.en: To come down and see my aunt and uncle.
sentences.zh: 来这里看望我的姑姑和姑父。

sentences.en: And how were those vacations?
sentences.zh: 那这些假期过得怎么样？

sentences.en: How were they?
sentences.zh: 怎么样？

sentences.en: Hot as heck.
sentences.zh: 热得要命。

sentences.en: As the years went on, Marion couldn't help but notice all the changes that were happening in the city.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月流逝，玛丽昂不禁注意到这座城市发生的所有变化。

sentences.en: More canals, more roads, and lots more people.
sentences.zh: 更多的运河、更多的道路，还有更多的人。

sentences.en: Every time I came down, I says, oh my God, one of these days God's going to get mad.
sentences.zh: 每次我来的时候，我都会说，天哪，总有一天上帝会发火的，

sentences.en: and just bring a big wave and just wash it all away
sentences.zh: 然后掀起滔天巨浪把这一切都冲走，

sentences.en: because they kept building and building and building and building.
sentences.zh: 因为他们一直在盖房子，不停地盖，不停地盖。

sentences.en: They took beautiful land and just destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 他们把美丽的土地彻底毁了。

sentences.en: And that biblical wave that Marion was worried about, it finally came.
sentences.zh: 而玛丽昂担心的那种圣经般的巨浪，最终还是来了。

sentences.en: In September 2022, Hurricane Ian made landfall not too far from Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 2022年9月，伊恩飓风在离珊瑚角不远的地方登陆。

sentences.en: I mean, when it hits the fan, it hits the fan.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当灾难降临时，它就是真的降临了。

sentences.en: so this is the first time the water river came into the house
sentences.zh: 所以这是河水第一次涌进屋里。

sentences.en: there's a saying that getting hit by a hurricane is a little like getting run over by a turtle
sentences.zh: 有句俗话说，被飓风袭击就像被乌龟碾过一样，

sentences.en: the days in the lead up to the storm are long everyone knows the latest forecast because
sentences.zh: 风暴来临前的日子很漫长，每个人都知道最新的预报，因为

sentences.en: everywhere you go there's at least one tv tuned to the local news you watch as the cone of
sentences.zh: 无论你走到哪里，至少有一台电视在播放当地新闻，你看着预报圆锥体

sentences.en: uncertainty narrows you go to publics you fill up your car the storm spins in the opposite direction
sentences.zh: 范围不断缩小，你去Publix超市采购，给车加满油，风暴却向相反方向旋转，

sentences.en: the clock ticks.
sentences.zh: 时钟在滴答作响。

sentences.en: You prepare on the off chance that it could be you, but no one ever feels ready
sentences.zh: 你做好了准备，以防万一轮到自己，但没人会觉得真的准备好了，

sentences.en: when it is.
sentences.zh: 当它真的来临时。

sentences.en: Outside, it came all the way up to the bottom of the windows.
sentences.zh: 在外面，水一直涨到了窗户底部。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And it looked like a
sentences.zh: 看起来就像一个

sentences.en: little mini tsunami running down the street.
sentences.zh: 小型的海啸在街上奔涌。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: So the next thing you know, this was
sentences.zh: 所以接下来发生的事，这就是

sentences.en: well, when you have three cats and two dogs, it's not likely you can run anywhere.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当你养了三只猫和两只狗时，你不可能跑去任何地方。

sentences.en: Hurricane Ian was the strongest storm the area had ever seen,
sentences.zh: 伊恩飓风是该地区有史以来见过的最强风暴，

sentences.en: and one of the worst in the history of the country.
sentences.zh: 也是这个国家历史上最严重的风暴之一。

sentences.en: It brought not only wind gusts of 140 miles per hour, but a massive storm surge.
sentences.zh: 它不仅带来了时速140英里的阵风，还带来了巨大的风暴潮。

sentences.en: The Caloosahatchee River overflowed its banks, and so did lots of canals in the city.
sentences.zh: 卡卢萨哈奇河（Caloosahatchee River）决堤了，城里的许多运河也一样。

sentences.en: It was a worst-case scenario, a massive, slow-moving, rain-heavy storm.
sentences.zh: 这是最坏的情况，一场巨大、移动缓慢、雨量充沛的风暴。

sentences.en: In parts of Cape Coral, high water marks were close to nine feet.
sentences.zh: 在珊瑚角的部分地区，洪水水位接近九英尺。

sentences.en: When we started flooded, I picked up one dog, he picked up the other,
sentences.zh: 当我们开始被淹时，我抱起一只狗，他抱起另一只，

sentences.en: and we put him on our tall dressers we had.
sentences.zh: 我们把它们放在了高高的梳妆台上。

sentences.en: And I'm sitting there on the one dresser of the chest and looking outside.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那个五斗橱上，看着外面。

sentences.en: And suddenly the shed that we had there, I watched the air just blow it apart from the inside out.
sentences.zh: 突然，我们那里的棚屋，我看着空气直接把它从里到外吹散了。

sentences.en: It just went poof.
sentences.zh: 它就这样“砰”地一声没了。

sentences.en: It was horrible.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: The flood water stayed in Marion's home overnight and receded by morning.
sentences.zh: 洪水在玛丽昂家里滞留了一夜，直到早上才退去。

sentences.en: When it was all said and done, she had two inches of mud to dig out of the house.
sentences.zh: 当一切结束时，她得从屋里清理出两英寸厚的淤泥。

sentences.en: She sifted through what could and couldn't be saved.
sentences.zh: 她仔细翻找着哪些东西能抢救，哪些不能。

sentences.en: Furniture she inherited from her aunt.
sentences.zh: 她从姑姑那里继承的家具。

sentences.en: Old remembrances.
sentences.zh: 旧时的纪念品。

sentences.en: Anything waterlogged sat at the end of her driveway.
sentences.zh: 所有被水浸透的东西都堆在车道尽头。

sentences.en: We had trash piled up.
sentences.zh: 我们堆满了垃圾。

sentences.en: Seven, eight feet tall down around here.
sentences.zh: 在这附近堆了七八英尺高。

sentences.en: All you could see is mounds and mounds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你看到的只有成堆成堆的杂物。

sentences.en: Together, Marion and Lloyd restored kitchen cabinets,
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂和劳埃德一起修复了厨房橱柜，

sentences.en: broke down old walls, and put in new floors.
sentences.zh: 拆掉了旧墙，铺上了新地板。

sentences.en: Work they largely did with their own hands and with their own money.
sentences.zh: 这些工作大部分是他们亲手完成的，用的也是他们自己的钱。

sentences.en: We didn't have flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 我们没有洪水保险。

sentences.en: A lot of stuff came out of our pocket.
sentences.zh: 很多钱都是我们自己掏的。

sentences.en: It hit my, a lot of our savings.
sentences.zh: 这冲击了我的，冲击了我们大部分的积蓄。

sentences.en: It really did.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: It did, big time.
sentences.zh: 确实，损失惨重。

sentences.en: I won't go into numbers and stuff, but it knocked us on our butt.
sentences.zh: 我就不提具体数字了，但这确实让我们陷入了困境。

sentences.en: Marion didn't have flood insurance,
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂没有洪水保险，

sentences.en: in part because of some really big changes
sentences.zh: 部分原因是联邦政府对

sentences.en: that the federal government made
sentences.zh: 国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）

sentences.en: to the National Flood Insurance Program.
sentences.zh: 做出了一些非常重大的调整。

sentences.en: Just a few months before Hurricane Ian,
sentences.zh: 就在伊恩飓风发生前几个月，

sentences.en: FEMA finally decided to correct the premiuMs.
sentences.zh: 联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）终于决定调整保费。

sentences.en: So now a lot of residents are discovering
sentences.zh: 所以现在很多居民开始发现，

sentences.en: what it looks like when the price matches the risk.
sentences.zh: 当价格与风险挂钩时会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Here's Carolyn Kuski again.
sentences.zh: 再次请出卡罗琳·库斯基（Carolyn Kuski）。

sentences.en: FEMA was underpricing risk.
sentences.zh: FEMA之前低估了风险。

sentences.en: And when you start accounting for it,
sentences.zh: 当你开始将其纳入考量时，

sentences.en: premiums have to go up.
sentences.zh: 保费就必须上涨。

sentences.en: And if you're going to have risk-based rates
sentences.zh: 如果你要在房产层面

sentences.en: at a property level,
sentences.zh: 实行基于风险的费率，

sentences.en: they are going to be expensive
sentences.zh: 那么在高风险地区，比如墨西哥湾沿岸，

sentences.en: in high-risk areas, like along the Gulf CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 保费就会变得非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And the Gulf Coast is the area where we're seeing the biggest price increases.
sentences.zh: 而墨西哥湾沿岸正是我们看到价格涨幅最大的地区。

sentences.en: The NFIP's new pricing model is called Risk Rating 2.0.
sentences.zh: NFIP的新定价模型被称为“风险评级2.0”（Risk Rating 2.0）。

sentences.en: I know, it sounds a little dystopian.
sentences.zh: 我知道，听起来有点反乌托邦。

sentences.en: Risk Rating 2.0 more accurately prices the risk of each individual home,
sentences.zh: 风险评级2.0能更准确地为每栋独立房屋的风险定价，

sentences.en: almost like a private insurer would.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像私人保险公司那样。

sentences.en: And Carolyn says that one of the counties experiencing the biggest rate hikes in Florida
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳说，佛罗里达州费率涨幅最大的县之一

sentences.en: is Lee County, where Cape Coral is located.
sentences.zh: 就是珊瑚角所在的李县（Lee County）。

sentences.en: The median premium under risk rating 2.0
sentences.zh: 在风险评级2.0下，中位数保费

sentences.en: is going to go up more than 250%.
sentences.zh: 将上涨超过250%。

sentences.en: FEMA created a glide path for longtime policyholders
sentences.zh: FEMA为长期投保人设立了一个过渡期，

sentences.en: that gradually increases rates over time.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移逐步提高费率。

sentences.en: But for residents who just saw their city flood
sentences.zh: 但对于那些刚目睹城市被淹，

sentences.en: and now want a new flood policy,
sentences.zh: 现在想要购买新洪水保险的居民来说，

sentences.en: they're going to have to pay the full, more expensive rate.
sentences.zh: 他们将不得不支付全额、更昂贵的费率。

sentences.en: And some of the people that I spoke with
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一些人

sentences.en: say that 250% actually underestimates the changes they've been seeing.
sentences.zh: 说250%实际上还低估了他们所经历的变化。

sentences.en: I called last year to see how much it would cost us to get flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 我去年打电话询问购买洪水保险需要多少钱。

sentences.en: They wanted $7,000.
sentences.zh: 他们要价7000美元。

sentences.en: Marion Morris was among the first citizens whose flood insurance rates skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂·莫里斯（Marion Morris）是首批洪水保险费率飙升的市民之一。

sentences.en: When she called to ask about a policy, it was the month before Ian.
sentences.zh: 当她打电话咨询保单时，那是在伊恩飓风来临的前一个月。

sentences.en: Some longtime residents used to pay $500 or $600 for flood insurance every year.
sentences.zh: 一些长期居民过去每年只需支付500或600美元的洪水保险。

sentences.en: But Marion's $7,000 quote would have meant an extra $500 or $600 coming out of her pocket every month.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽昂那7000美元的报价意味着她每个月要额外多掏500或600美元。

sentences.en: For two seniors on a fixed income, they just couldn't swing it.
sentences.zh: 对于两位靠固定收入生活的老人来说，他们根本负担不起。

sentences.en: So they didn't have flood insurance for one of the worst floods ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，在遭遇史上最严重的洪水之一时，他们没有洪水保险。

sentences.en: They had to rebuild their home with their own money.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不自掏腰包重建家园。

sentences.en: And they still don't have insurance to protect them from the next flood.
sentences.zh: 而且他们现在依然没有保险来抵御下一次洪水。

sentences.en: When I spoke to Marion, she sounded defeated by the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 当我与玛丽昂交谈时，她听起来被这一切击垮了。

sentences.en: The recovery, the financial gymnastics, the anxiety of summer, it's all just been too much.
sentences.zh: 灾后重建、财务周转、夏天的焦虑，这一切都太沉重了。

sentences.en: I'm just going to have to put it in God's hands.
sentences.zh: 我只能把它交给上帝了。

sentences.en: If it floods, it's not going to do me any good.
sentences.zh: 如果再发洪水，我也无能为力。

sentences.en: You know, there's nothing I can do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我什么也做不了。

sentences.en: You know, grin and bear it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，只能忍气吞声。

sentences.en: That's all.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: That's what we do.
sentences.zh: 我们只能这样。

sentences.en: Everyone's having insurance issues.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在经历保险问题。

sentences.en: And insurance has become a nightmare in Florida all the way around.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达，保险已经变成了一场彻头彻尾的噩梦。

sentences.en: Again, Gloria Razo Tate, the daughter of Joseph Razo, who worked for the Rosens at Gulf American.
sentences.zh: 再次介绍格洛丽亚·拉佐·泰特（Gloria Razo Tate），她是约瑟夫·拉佐（Joseph Razo）的女儿，约瑟夫曾为海湾美国公司的罗森家族工作。

sentences.en: In addition to being one of the first residents of Cape Coral, Gloria has made a name for herself in the city.
sentences.zh: 作为珊瑚角最早的居民之一，格洛丽亚在城里也闯出了名堂。

sentences.en: She's the owner of Razo Realty and has continued the tradition of her father, selling the Florida dream.
sentences.zh: 她是拉佐房地产公司（Razo Realty）的老板，延续了她父亲推销“佛罗里达梦”的传统。

sentences.en: Back when Hurricane Ian hit, Gloria was also on the city council, representing the oldest part of the city and the one most affected by the hurricane.
sentences.zh: 伊恩飓风袭击时，格洛丽亚还是市议会议员，代表着这座城市最古老、受飓风影响最严重的地区。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a year later and people are still not satisfied with their claims or still working through it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一年过去了，人们对理赔结果仍然不满意，或者还在处理中。

sentences.en: Gloria tells me that insurance, almost more than anything, has people reconsidering moving to Cape Coral.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚告诉我，保险问题比其他任何事情都更让人们重新考虑是否要搬到珊瑚角。

sentences.en: As a realtor selling property, I just shudder when I have to tell someone that they need flood insurance and where it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 作为一名销售房产的房地产经纪人，当我不得不告诉别人他们需要购买洪水保险，以及保费会涨到什么程度时，我不禁感到战栗。

sentences.en: Have you seen that influence people in making decisions?
sentences.zh: 你见过这种情况影响人们的决策吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: Gloria worries that because risk rating 2.0 is so aggressive,
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚担心，由于风险评级2.0过于激进，

sentences.en: eventually FEMA will place the entire city in a flood zone,
sentences.zh: 最终FEMA会将整个城市划入洪水区，

sentences.en: which could dramatically increase the number of people with mortgages
sentences.zh: 这可能会大幅增加背负抵押贷款的人数，

sentences.en: who'd have to purchase very expensive flood insurance.
sentences.zh: 他们将不得不购买非常昂贵的洪水保险。

sentences.en: And Florida's state-run home insurance program,
sentences.zh: 而佛罗里达州运营的房屋保险计划，

sentences.en: they're planning to increase rates too.
sentences.zh: 他们也计划提高费率。

sentences.en: Not exactly because of climate reasons.
sentences.zh: 这倒不完全是因为气候原因。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've heard, but the governor isn't really about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有听说，但州长对此并不怎么上心。

sentences.en: But because he wants more people buying private insurance
sentences.zh: 但因为他希望更多人购买私人保险，

sentences.en: and getting off of the state's bag.
sentences.zh: 从而不再依赖州政府的救济。

sentences.en: All of the experts that I spoke with for this story
sentences.zh: 我在撰写这篇报道时采访的所有专家都表示，

sentences.en: say that one of the first steps in untangling this insurance problem
sentences.zh: 解决这场保险危机的首要步骤之一，

sentences.en: is to eventually price insurance accurately
sentences.zh: 是最终实现保险定价的精准化，

sentences.en: so that it reflects the amount of risk a homeowner is really facing.
sentences.zh: 使其能够反映房主真正面临的风险程度。

sentences.en: And that is starting to happen.
sentences.zh: 而这已经开始发生了。

sentences.en: It's just the way it's happening,
sentences.zh: 只是这种发生的方式，

sentences.en: it makes it almost impossible for people like Marion and Gloria,
sentences.zh: 让像玛丽恩和格洛丽亚这样的人几乎陷入了绝境，

sentences.en: residents with roots in Cape Coral,
sentences.zh: 她们是在开普科勒尔扎根的居民，

sentences.en: who built a life here precisely because of its affordability.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这里生活负担得起，她们才在此安家落户。

sentences.en: And that's one of the main criticisms of Risk Rating 2.0,
sentences.zh: 这也是对“风险评级2.0”的主要批评之一，

sentences.en: that this new policy is going to hurt places like Cape Coral disproportionately,
sentences.zh: 即这项新政策将对开普科勒尔这样的地方造成不成比例的伤害，

sentences.en: especially the working-class people who live there.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对居住在那里的工薪阶层。

sentences.en: And it has.
sentences.zh: 事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: But that's also because that's kind of the point.
sentences.zh: 但这在某种程度上也是它的目的所在。

sentences.en: It's supposed to hurt.
sentences.zh: 它本就旨在造成阵痛。

sentences.en: In that respect, the 2.0 and the FEMA maps and all of that,
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，2.0版本、联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）的地图以及所有这些措施，

sentences.en: they are here to protect us.
sentences.zh: 它们的存在是为了保护我们。

sentences.en: It's just they weren't here at the beginning, and the retrofit can bankrupt most people.
sentences.zh: 只是它们起初并不存在，而改造工程可能会让大多数人破产。

sentences.en: The retrofit is painful.
sentences.zh: 改造过程是痛苦的。

sentences.en: The retrofit is painful, yeah.
sentences.zh: 改造过程确实很痛苦。

sentences.en: Gloria tells me that since the hurricane, people have had to make some really hard choices about where they live, including her, because Ian destroyed her home too.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚告诉我，飓风过后，人们不得不对居住地做出非常艰难的选择，她自己也不例外，因为伊恩飓风也摧毁了她的家。

sentences.en: I had almost four feet of water in my home, a sewer line break.
sentences.zh: 我家里的积水深达近四英尺，下水道也破裂了。

sentences.en: I had a 62-year-old tree that fell in the middle of my house, and that was that.
sentences.zh: 我院子里那棵62年的老树倒在了房子中间，一切就这样完了。

sentences.en: I was in shock, so it took me a few days to actually wrap myself around it, what had happened.
sentences.zh: 我当时处于震惊之中，所以花了几天时间才真正接受所发生的一切。
